title: Trip planner Japan, month view with stays (en)

alt.en: The month view of a Japan trip from 1 to 10 December 2026: for each day the park, the crowd level and the opening hours as a bar, and under each date the band of the city, Tokyo first, then Osaka from the travel day on the 6th.

caption.en: The number in the band is the stay, the arrow on 6 December the hotel change. A line under the grid explains the band before the crowd colours.
